messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary v13b (us-west-2) p99 spike for /v1/generate (streaming).
metrics: p95 120ms -> 420ms, p99 480ms -> 2.4s, errors steady. Traffic: 5% canary. Started 2026-02-28T03:22:15Z. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/canary-latency

mike: paging oncall @miguel @olivia - canary traffic is causing streaming tail spikes, p99 breach.

miguel: ack, I'm oncall. Joining bridge. Investigating runtime logs and ingress.

aj: looking at runtime traces — encoder queue depth jumped and there's sustained KV cache miss ratio increase (misses 82%). Logs below:
```
[2026-02-28T03:22:18Z] encode.ms=18 queue.len=2 kv.miss=true
[2026-02-28T03:23:02Z] encode.ms=220 queue.len=67 kv.miss=true
[2026-02-28T03:24:10Z] encode.ms=1400 queue.len=102 kv.miss=true streaming.chunk_gap=10s
```

olivia: streaming clients show intermittent EOFs and gap>10s between chunks. Looks like encoder stalls. Could be model kernel or quant layer introduced in v13b.

mike: can we reduce canary immediately? command:
```
redwoodctl rollout traffic --model v13b --set-canary 1
```

opsbot: Running traffic-shift. Request accepted. New canary pct: 1% (was 5%).

aj: also increased replica limits for canary pods (4 -> 8) while we investigate. CPU not saturated, waiting on backend queue.

olivia: recommend pin customers with streaming SLAs to v12 until stabilized. Suggesting rolling rollback as next step.

sophia: customer impact: two customers (acme-corp, betaworks) reported ~30s streaming timeouts between 03:22 and 03:46 UTC. SEV3 declared. No data corruption.

miguel: initiating rollback plan. Commands:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service runtime --from v13b --to v12 --strategy immediate
```

bridge-bot: Incident bridge created: https://zoom.redwood/incident-5012349999

aj: quick sanity — KV cache warmup absent on v13b due to metadata schema change. Warmup traffic not hit because canary started cold. Hitting warmup endpoints now:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.warmup/v13b -d '{"prefixes": ["Hello","Q:"]}'
```

opsbot: Rollback started. Progress: 0% -> 12% -> 56% -> 100%. All canary nodes switching back to v12.

olivia: observing p99 coming back down toward baseline. p95 recovery faster. Streaming chunk gaps disappearing.

mike: good. miguel please verify customer retries and any residual 5xxs.

miguel: checked 5xx rate: small spike during 03:23-03:29 then back to baseline after rollback. No persistent errors.

sophia: notifying account teams for acme-corp and betaworks. Draft message: "We saw increased streaming latency during the 03:22-03:46 UTC window due to a canary model rollout. We rolled back and are investigating root cause; follow-up coming." Requesting CS to send now.

sara: taking post-rollback ownership for RCA with eng-runtime. I'll collect traces and kernel-level profiles. Adding follow-ups: warmup automation for new model variants, traffic ramp gating based on KV-warmup success, stricter stream p99 checks in canary policy.

mike: oncall handoff in 20m. miguel please add a short incident summary and escalate to eng-runtime if any regression in next hour.

miguel: summary posted to incident doc. handing off to @sara (eng-runtime). Thanks all. :thumbsup:

bridge-bot: Handoff complete — closing incident bridge. Please file postmortem and link here.
